title.en: Optimize Water Distribution in a Village

desc.zh: 每户各自贪心会一口井都不打；把打井画成通向水源的管，问题就变成最小生成树。
desc.en: Per-house greed digs no well at all; draw each well as a pipe to a water source and the problem becomes a minimum spanning tree.

concepts.name: Virtual water source
concepts.description: A well at house i is an edge from source 0 to i, so every house must connect to 0.

concepts.name: Kruskal with union-find
concepts.description: Take edges cheapest first and skip any whose ends are already in one group.
